title: Chapter 195 - 195 Can I Buy Some?
content:
Chapter 195 - 195 Can I Buy Some?

Chapter 195 - 195 Can I Buy Some?

195 Can I Buy Some?

Tang Jiao and Du Yujia, who were in the helicopter, were equally surprised.

However, they were relatively restrained.

They only touched around for a while…

Perhaps it was because they had been under the sun for too long, their little faces gradually blushed.

After a long time, Lin Xiaoyao, Tang Jiao, and Du Yujia reluctantly got out of the helicopter.

Lin Xiaoyao looked at the helicopter, then at the supercar beside it, and then at the tall villas…

Like a general inspecting soldiers, she nodded in satisfaction and said, “As expected of my house!”

Finally, she said, “Brother, let’s go buy Flower Stem’s essence!”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

Hence, Lin Fan and the rest were once again escorted out by two rows of security guards.

Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class through the wide roads and soon arrived at the downtown area.

Lin Xiaoyao, Tang Jiao, and Du Yujia looked at the flourishing shops and yearned to go inside.

“Stop!” Lin Xiaoyao suddenly shouted. “Brother, stop!”

Hiss!

Lin Fan stepped on the brakes and asked, “What’s wrong?”

“Flower Stem! It’s Flower Stem’s shop!” Lin Xiaoyao pointed at the crowded shop not far away and shouted excitedly.

Then, she, Tang Jiao, and Du Yujia ran over excitedly.

However, after a while, the three of them walked back listlessly.

“Flower Stem’s essence here is also sold out,” Lin Xiaoyao sighed.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Get in! The place I’m taking you to will definitely have the essence!”

“Really?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

“When have I ever lied to you?” Lin Fan said.

Then, Lin Fan started the Mercedes-Benz G-Class again and continued to move forward.

Not long after, the Feiyang Building appeared in everyone’s sight.

The most eye-catching spot in the Feiyang Building was the advertisement for Flower Stem.

“Flower Stem! This is Flower Stem’s headquarters?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

“Not bad. You have some knowledge,” Lin Fan said.

When Lin Xiaoyao, Tang Jiao, and Du Yujia heard this, they all looked excited.

Flower Stem’s headquarters!

They would definitely have the essence!

The group took the elevator and went straight to the 17th floor!

Ding!

As the elevator door opened, a refreshing fragrance greeted them.

Through the glass, they could see the busy figures of the employees in the office.

Lin Fan did not say anything and walked in.

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao pointed at the sign in front of the door. ‘Non-employees are not allowed to enter.’

After the success of Rainbow Perfume and Flower Stem Essence, Flower Stem became extremely popular.

Especially after the launch of Flower Stem Essence, countless businessmen came to seek cooperation every day, and countless consumers wanted to come and buy the essence.

Too many people entered the company, making it difficult for Flower Stem to carry out its normal work.

That was why non-employees were barred from entering.

Lin Fan did not seem to hear Lin Xiaoyao’s words or see the sign. He led the way in.

The receptionist noticed someone coming in and stopped what she was doing and looked up.

Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao thought, ‘It’s over, it’s over. We’re going to be chased out.’

However…

The next moment, the three of them were stunned.

The beautiful receptionist quickly stood up and said in a very sweet voice, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded his head and said casually, “Hello.”

Although it was just a polite greeting, it made the beautiful receptionist smile even wider.

“Mr. Lin, are you here to look for the president? She should be in the office now.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

Then, Lin Fan continued walking in.

However, he soon noticed that Lin Xiaoyao and the others were standing still. He could not help but turn around and say, “Lil Yao, what are you guys doing there? Let’s go.”

“Ah… Alright… Alright.”

Lin Xiaoyao answered and followed him, though a little stiffly.

Just as she was about to ask something, she had already arrived at the door of the president’s office.

Thus, she could only swallow her words back.

Lin Fan raised his hand and knocked on the door. Soon, a crisp voice sounded from inside.

“Please come in.”

At this moment, Chu Yunyue was working on some documents with her head lowered. She looked tired but satisfied.

When she raised her head and saw the person who walked in, her beautiful face immediately revealed a touch of unconcealable joy.

“Lin Fan, you’re here!”

Soon, she noticed Lin Xiaoyao and the others standing beside Lin Fan.

“This is my sister, Lin Xiaoyao, and her classmates, Du Yujia and Tang Jiao,” Lin Fan introduced.

When Chu Yunyue heard this, the smile on her pretty face widened.

“Hello! My name is Chu Yunyue,” Chu Yunyue said happily.

“President Chu, you’re so beautiful,” Lin Xiaoyao could not help but praise.

Any woman would like to hear compliments from others, and Chu Yunyue was no exception.

“Thank you for your praise, Lil Yao. You’re very cute too. In the future, you’ll definitely be more beautiful than me! Also, it’s too formal to call me President. Just call me Sister Chu.”

“Yes, yes!” Lin Xiaoyao nodded vigorously.

After chatting for a while, the few of them became quite familiar with each other.

Lin Xiaoyao finally revealed the purpose of her trip.

“Sister Chu, we want to buy some Flower Stem Essence. Do you still have it in stock?” Lin Xiaoyao asked with anticipation.

When Chu Yunyue heard this, she could not help but look at Lin Fan strangely.

It was as if she was saying, ‘You brought your sister here to buy essence?’

That was because Flower Stem Essence was blended with Lin Fan’s Beauty Water. It was just that they had added some other spices.

Lin Fan shrugged his shoulders helplessly.

Lin Xiaoyan saw that Chu Yunyue did not say anything and could not help but droop her head. She said pitifully, “Is there no more stock?”

“We still have a lot of stock!” Chu Yunyue smiled. “Let’s go, I’ll bring you over! Today, you can take as much as you want!”

“Really? That’s great!” Lin Xiaoyao jumped up in joy.

Du Yujia’s and Tang Jiao’s eyes also lit up with excitement.

Then, they went straight to the product department under Chu Yunyue’s lead.

There were many boxes here, and each box was filled with Flower Stem Essence.

Lin Xiaoyao could not help but swallow her saliva and say, “S-Sister Chu, can we really take anything we want?”

“Of course, there’s a bag over there,” said Chu Yunyue.

Then, Lin Xiaoyao looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Go get it.”

“Then we won’t stand on ceremony!” Lin Xiaoyao said.

Thus, Lin Xiaoyao, Du Yujia, and Tang Jiao filled a large bag with different types of Flower Stem’s essence products. They were almost unable to carry the bags, and they left the product department satisfied.
